objective: Select per-episode reliable cues from independently inserted raw token streams, without aligned slots or a known symbol substitution.
learner: terminal-reward learned token-pair compatibility plus monotonic sequence alignment; no oracle references/cipher
baselines: fixed-source identity from same choices and terminal reward
unsupervised windowed token-permutation plus monotonic alignment, equal observations
primary_metric: simulated navigation successes per 40 episodes and aggregate
restrictions: Freeze algorithms/budgets and both cohorts before first evaluation
No hidden cipher or true positions to learner or unsupervised baseline
No target paired supervision; only binary navigation success rewards in learner fit
Retain negative results, including simple baseline gains
No automatic action authorization or default deployment
These seeds have been inspected in preceding studies and are not independent blind cohorts
note: Exploratory research D3 gate stays open even if navigation improves.
